newsitem.title: USA: NOXSO names Kilpela chief executive.
newsitem.headline: NOXSO names Kilpela chief executive.

text.p: NOXSO Corp said it has named Edwin Kilpela as its new president and chief executive officer.
The company said Kilpela succeeds previous president L.G. Neal, who will remain with the company.

"The Board of Directors believes that Mr. Kilpela brings to NOXSO the talents that will greatly assist the company in its ongoing efforts to commercialize the NOXSO process. His unique background including environmental, utility and international experience will serve the company well," Neal said.
